create_vocoder_model: create a PretsselVocoder model from a VocoderConfig with optional device and dtype
build_PretsselVocoderBuilder_model: build a complete PretsselVocoder model using the PretsselVocoderBuilder with config and prosody encoder builder
build_PretsselVocoderBuilder_fft: build a FeedForwardTransformer encoder or decoder with specified number of FFT layers
build_PretsselVocoderBuilder_variance_ad: build a VarianceAdaptor module with pitch, energy, and VUV predictors for prosody modeling
register_vocoder_arch: register a VocoderConfig under the vocoder_archs architecture registry with a named variant
